notes.title: Keebles launch special - 4 free games plus 20% discount
notes.content:
http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-VJNuKRGkTlg/VRFTEP_Vd9I/AAAAAAAAAfY/PpwAb7ySm6k/s1600/Keebles-Free4_Blog_Banner.jpg


As a launch special, Green Man Gaming are giving away 4 free games with every purchase of Keebles (at a 20% discount) till 30 March 2015.

Because you know Keebles is worth 4 other games put together.

The 4 games are:

 Clickr 
 PID 
 Rabbit Hole 3D 
 Rooms: The Main Building 


http://blog.playfire.com/2015/03/keebles-unleashed-this-week-buy-now-get.html
